headlines.title: Thanksgiving travelers face long airport lines and packed roads
headlines.description: Thousands of flights are canceled or delayed because of storms on one of the busiest travel days of the year. On the roads, families are ending up in standstill traffic.

headlines.title: Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade Postponed for First Time Ever
headlines.description: For the first time in its 100-year history, the world-famous Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade has been postponed. The unprecedented decision by Macy’s and New York City was made after forecasters warned of potentially dangerous storm conditions. NBC’s Erin McLaughlin reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Trump Administration Defends Iowa Detonation, Unveils New Tariffs
headlines.description: The White House is calling the controversial detonation of old explosives in Iowa a success, saying there is no health impact. This comes as the Trump administration reignites fears over a new trade war, proposing sweeping tariffs targeting 11 countries, the European Union and China. NBC’s Kelly O’Donnell reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: US Troops in Poland Get a Taste of Thanksgiving
headlines.description: Under the frozen skies of northern Poland, American troops are running combat drills, training to perform under pressure in cramped cabins and assembling the communications antennas that are so critical to modern warfare. Although the troops can’t make it home, the military does its best to bring the Thanksgiving holiday to them. NBC’s Raf Sanchez reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: American entrepreneurs move to China’s tech hub
headlines.description: NBC Nightly News anchor Tom Llamas reports from Shenzhen, where some American entrepreneurs are betting on China’s tech boom despite its weakening economy.

headlines.title: Black Friday deals are here, and they’re actually really good — I’m tracking the best ones live
headlines.description: Shop Black Friday 2026 deals on tech, home, kitchen, beauty, fashion and more. NBC Selected editors reviewed thousands of discounts to find top-rated products and standout savings worth shopping now.

headlines.title: How are you affording the holidays?
headlines.description: After a year of high gas prices, inflation ticking back up and a lot of Americans feeling pessimistic about the economy, we want to know how people are affording the annual wave of holiday gifts, travel and entertainment costs.

headlines.title: ‘Shocking’ decline seen in hep B vaccination against incurable virus, including babies with infected mothers
headlines.description: Fewer newborns are being vaccinated against hepatitis B, an incurable infection that can lead to liver disease, a large new analysis has found.

headlines.title: More than 700,000 Russian soldiers killed in Ukraine war, new estimate suggests
headlines.description: More than 700,000 Russian soldiers have been killed in Ukraine, according to a new projection based on leaked official data, an estimate that sheds new light on the staggering cost of President Vladimir Putin’s war.

headlines.title: 2026 Rockefeller Center Christmas Tree Arrives in New York City
headlines.description: A magnificent Norway spruce has made its journey from West Edmeston, New York, to Rockefeller Center. The tree will undergo a glow-up ahead of the lighting ceremony on Dec. 2.

headlines.title: Pregnant inmate escapes from New Mexico corrections facility
headlines.description: Authorities are searching for a pregnant inmate who escaped from a New Mexico corrections facility on Wednesday.

headlines.title: Iowa residents mark Thanksgiving with lingering fears after chemical detonation
headlines.description: The U.S. Army blew up the nation’s entire stockpile of lead azide, a chemical used to make explosives, saying the first checks show Wednesday’s controlled detonation in Iowa didn’t spread toxic dust to nearby homes and farms.
